maps.divergesFromUpstream: This copy is the upstream map with two engine-authored fields added to every entry the engine implements: status, raised from 'mapped' to 'implemented', and implementedIn, naming the ruleset and version that implements it. Two entries additionally carry an engine-authored note (must-play-whole-throw, stake-multiplier) recording that they are implemented and decline a stated case, which status has no value for -- finding 12 in MAP-FINDINGS.md. Nothing else differs: no locator, evidence, clarity, scope, dependsOn, gatedBy or ambiguity here has been edited, and corrections this build found are recorded in MAP-FINDINGS.md rather than applied.
maps.whyPinned: The map is the oracle scripts/validate.sh validates the code against, and the engine writes into it. Unpinned, an edit to the oracle would look the same as an edit to the code passing.
